_doc: Which Arabic REGISTER each surface is written in. This file is the policy
made executable: style-guide.md explains the reasoning, this decides.
eg  = Egyptian Arabic (عامية مصرية). What the STUDIO reads while working.
msa = Modern Standard Arabic (فصحى). What the CLIENT reads, and every
document — contracts, quotations, the delivery portal, PDFs.
LONGEST MATCHING PREFIX WINS, so order here is presentational only and a
narrow rule can sit anywhere relative to the broad one it carves out of.
A client signing an acknowledgement written in عامية does not read as
friendly, it reads as unserious — which is why the line is drawn by WHO IS

rules.why: Search titles and descriptions and the share card: read by anyone in a search result or a WhatsApp preview, not on-screen studio copy (lead ruling on the SEO plan, Oct 27).
The generic 404 page: any visitor can land on it, a client following a broken link included.
The end-client delivery portal. The client opens this, not the studio.
The exception inside it: the studio's own 'Share with client' control, which no client ever sees.
The client's electronic acknowledgement page. A legal instrument.
The client's decision page on a change to their contract. A legal instrument.
The client-facing quotation: accept, reject, VAT, totals.
Client-facing errors on every link page.
Rendered on the client token pages, so it must match their register.
